data.title: AI bear slams Nvidia's GPU pitch: 'There's not scarcity other than that which is created by Jensen Huang'
data.description: Ed Zitron, CEO of public relations firm EZPR and well-known critic of the AI spending boom, says Nvidia is creating the scarcity it sells against.
